evidence_quotes: Overtreding van artikel 6.2, eerste lid, van de Waterwet.
rationale: The decision concerns administrative enforcement (last onder dwangsom) against the holding company of a bankrupt butcher shop for violating Article 6.2(1) of the Dutch Waterwet, which prohibits discharging substances into surface water bodies without a water permit (watervergunning). It directly adjudicates statutory water discharge regulation under the Waterwet and does not involve household service connection or informal settlements.
